date.description: The UTC day the rate is for; a load for today's date holds the latest rate at load time, not the day's closing value.

base.description: Three-letter code of the currency every rate on the row is relative to; USD unless the connector's base is changed, which needs a Developer, Enterprise or Unlimited plan.

currency.description: Three-letter code of the currency the rate is quoted in.

rate.description: Units of `currency` for one unit of `base`: the last value Open Exchange Rates published for that UTC day.
